Timex · ref. TW4B14100

Expedition Scout

Field · 40mm · 50m · quartz

The Timex Expedition Scout is a family of analog field watches known for its military-inspired, legible design and rugged durability at an accessible price point. Signature features often include a 12/24-hour time scale, a date function, and Timex's Indiglo backlight for visibility in low light.

The story

The broader Expedition line was introduced in the mid-1990s to cater to the growing popularity of outdoor activities. The Scout sub-family emerged as a classic and straightforward field watch, embodying the collection's spirit of adventure with a more traditional, military-inspired aesthetic. While early Expedition models included digital watches, the Scout has consistently been an analog timepiece. It has remained a popular choice due to its simple, functional design and robust build, making it a reliable and unpretentious tool watch for everyday wear and outdoor pursuits.
